title: Integrate run history and navigation with accessible slide-out drawers
description: Provide a left slide-out history drawer for optimization runs/interactive sessions and edition history, scoped to selected scorecard with search/filter and active/inspected distinction. Keep it closed during focused labeling by default; do not permanently consume labeling width. Provide app-level navigation accessible at narrow sizes, deep links and browser back/forward preserving selected scorecard/run/view. Drawer opening is local UI state, not a run mutation; retain current item, pending job and unsaved comments/labels on close or navigation cancellation. Focus management, Escape, backdrop dismissal, accessible names and touch targets. Acceptance: open history, inspect another run, return to active session with drafts intact; tablet overlay never obscures unreachable dismiss/actions; inactive editions clearly read-only until explicitly activated.

comments.author: home
comments.text: History now uses a dismissible left drawer instead of permanent side column. Selecting a run or creating a run closes drawer; current item remains mounted while opening/closing it. Remaining: scorecard-scoped filtering/search, proper browser back/forward and preservation of drafts when switching runs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added browser back/forward route restoration, run-name search and scorecard filtering. Unsent multi-classifier labels and explanations persist per immutable prediction presentation in session storage; unavailable/malformed storage does not block labeling. New-run setup moved from inline cards to a dismissible right drawer; browser checked Create run reachable at 720px height, closing returns to unchanged live item. Remaining: selected scorecard deep links, edition read-only distinction, tablet and keyboard acceptance across run switching.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Selected scorecard now has a scorecard=<id> deep link. WebApp preserves this routing parameter and browser Back restores the selected card; tested in components and live Anthus browser. No configuration changes, human labels, or model calls were produced by navigation. Remaining: inspected revision deep links, inactive-edition read-only distinction and tablet/keyboard cross-run draft acceptance.
